questions.q: How many units of Industrial Pump Bearing, Model PB-4400, does Dana request in this course's transaction?
questions.explain: Dana submits a requisition for 50 units of the PB-4400 bearing to restock LTV's maintenance supply.

questions.q: Which chapter covers change orders and closing/cancelling the purchase order?
questions.explain: Chapter 3 covers creating, approving, changing, and closing/cancelling the purchase order using this course's example PO.

questions.q: What document number first appears in Chapter 2 and is then referenced on the purchase order line in Chapter 3?
questions.explain: The requisition number is created when Dana submits her request and is carried forward onto the purchase order line that fulfills it.

questions.q: What happens in Chapter 6 that is different from Chapters 2 through 5?
options: Nothing — it simply repeats Chapter 1 word for word
The company name changes from LTV Manufacturing to a different company
A completely new, unrelated transaction is introduced
The whole cycle is replayed end to end, and exception scenarios are deliberately introduced to break the expected checkpoints
questions.explain: Chapter 6 replays the full cycle in one sitting and then deliberately introduces exception scenarios so you can practice recognizing when something has gone wrong.

questions.q: Who is the receiving clerk who confirms the bearings physically arrived at LTV's dock?
questions.explain: Priya Nandan is the receiving clerk in this course's running transaction.
